title: A randomized trial of the effects of the no-carrageenan diet on ulcerative colitis disease activity
authors: Bhattacharyya S, Shumard T, Xie H, Dodda A, Varady KA, Feferman L, et al.
population: Adults with ulcerative colitis in remission on a no-carrageenan diet
funder: The study was supported by the Broad Medical Research Program.
inKindSupport: Food-grade carrageenan obtained from FMC Biopolymer; capsules prepared by the Chau Center for Industrial Pharmacy and Contract Manufacturing.
authorConflicts: The authors have no conflicts of interest with regard to the content of this report.
result: Double-blind capsules of 100 mg food-grade carrageenan or dextrose placebo. Relapse in 3 of 5 participants given carrageenan and 0 of 7 given placebo (log-rank P = 0.046); interleukin-6 rose in the carrageenan group (P = 0.02). EFSA (2018) judged the study of limited relevance because of the small number of patients.
